gizmo.title: Xaalad laamo leh
gizmo.description: Sheeko doorasho kastaa ay u horseeddo muuqaal iyo dhammaad kala duwan. Ardaydu dib bay u noqon karaan oo isku dayi karaan waddooyin kale; dhammaadka la gaaro ayaa go'aamiya dhibcaha.

configure.title: Cinwaan
configure.description: Magaca xaaladda, oo ka muuqda madaxeeda.

configure.title: Muuqaalka bilowga
configure.description: ID-ga muuqaalka ardaydu ka bilaabaan. Ka tag madhan si aad uga bilowdo muuqaalka ugu horreeya.

advanced.title: Midabka xoojinta
advanced.description: Midab ikhtiyaari ah oo loogu talagalay chip-ka madaxa, badhamada iyo geeska doorashada.
